value.title: Sensitive Content Discovery & Backup Artifact Auditing
value.content: {"id": "recon_meth_005", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "recon", "name": "Sensitive Content Discovery & Backup Artifact Auditing", "prerequisites": ["http_status_codes", "differential_analysis"], "signals": ["sensitive_file_extension", "backup_artifacts", "dot_files", "admin_portal", "git_exposure"], "verification_strategy": "Conduct dictionary-based probing for high-risk configuration artifacts (.env, .git, .bak, .sql, .dump). Validate true findings using content-length and content-type differentiation to eliminate soft-404 false positives.", "evidence_requirements": ["artifact_status_200_proof", "magic_bytes_or_content_hash", "non_default_response_body"], "remediation_pattern": "Block public access to hidden dot-files and backup file extensions at the web server / reverse proxy layer (e.g., Nginx deny rules).", "description": "Identification of exposed backup archives, database dumps, environment variable files, and source code control repositories accidentally placed in web roots."}
